title: shorea macroptera subsp. baillonii
intro: Shorea macroptera subsp. baillonii, commonly known as the Philippine mahogany or bantak, is a subspecies of tree that belongs to the family Dipterocarpaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine in the Philippines for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Shorea macroptera subsp. baillonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, contributing to its therapeutic actions in reducing fever, relieving cough, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiviral properties, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine.
